features.title: CRITICAL ENVIRONMENT BUG: files written via Write/Edit tools get corrupted on Windows shared filesystem F:\СМП\...
features.user_visible_behavior: Files authored through the Write tool get 0x00 bytes appended after content (parsers stop at first null). The Edit tool sometimes truncates files mid-content. Both patterns silently corrupt downstream tooling. Files written via bash redirect (`cat > file << EOF`) are clean.
verification: Reproduce null-padding: write configs/experiment_setups.yaml via Write -> YAML loader raises 'unacceptable character #x0000' at byte 338.
Reproduce via cat > .. << EOF -> 0 null bytes, parses correctly.

Confirmed in session 023: feature_list.json was truncated mid-string by Edit tool, restored from HEAD.

Workaround: after every Write/Edit on F:\СМП\..., run `python3 -c 'b=open(F,"rb").read(); assert b.count(0)==0; json.loads(b) or yaml.safe_load(b) as appropriate'`. If it fails, re-author via `cat > F << EOF`.
Permanent fix: report to cowork environment maintainers — sandbox->Windows file sync corruption. Likely fixed-size buffer being flushed regardless of content length, or volume alignment quirk.
